answer: Guarantor admission is a rental deposit: a newcomer enters only when an agent stakes funds on them. The sponsor locks 200 units for 15 epochs, the newcomer 100; a vine of endorsements caps a sponsor at two newcomers per epoch. Honest work frees stakes after 6 epochs; forgery slashes the newcomer fully and the sponsor 50%. A jetty of 1,000 clones needs 500 sponsors holding 100,000 units; at 30% detection the voyage costs 45,000 units.
